module.adapterState: const adapterState=createAdapterStateProvider(execution.adapters); pass adapterState to new ApprovalBridge({executionFacade:execution, adapterState, ledger:new ReviewLedger({storagePath:path.join(runtimeDirectory,'approval-bridge.sqlite'), now})}); the provider calls the actual synchronous adapters.status(), fingerprints adapters.browserContextId, adapters.pages and adapters.selectedWindow, and advances generation on any context/page/window/connection/closed change.
module.ledger: new ReviewLedger({storagePath:path.join(runtimeDirectory,'approval-bridge.sqlite'), now}) or pass an equivalent injected durable ledger
module.browserLease: Root owns the browser fixture lease. The adapter owns a headless browser context; the UI must label it that way.

serverHooks.location: intentgraph/server.cjs route before existing POST /api/action dispatch
serverHooks.requiredBehavior: Return 403 APPROVAL_BRIDGE_REQUIRED for execution.adapter operations browser.preview/browser.execute/desktop.preview/desktop.execute. Do not rely on the bridge-local handler to protect the generic route.

serverHooks.location: intentgraph/server.cjs route before generic action/static fallthrough
serverHooks.requiredBehavior: For /api/approval-bridge/* write JSON with outcome.status/outcome.headers/outcome.body and return. All preview/review/approve/execute calls carry exact Origin, X-Aven-Approval, scoped token, session, generation, connection and scope headers.
Close the owned durable receipt ledger. Do not close or replace unrelated execution adapters.

uiHooks.mount: const workspaceBridge=globalThis.__avenWorkspaceExecutionBridge; if(!workspaceBridge) throw new Error('The existing workspace execution bridge is unavailable.'); let workspaceKind=''; const workspaceCall=async(kind,operation,input={})=>{if(workspaceKind!==kind||!workspaceBridge.isConnected?.()){await workspaceBridge.connect(kind); workspaceKind=kind;} const response=await workspaceBridge.call(kind,operation,input); if(!response?.ok) throw new Error(response?.reason||'The authorized workspace adapter rejected the operation.'); return response.result;}; const client=createApprovalBridgeClient({basePath:'/api/approval-bridge',origin:window.location.origin,currentChatId,getMode,adapterClient:{openBrowser:(url)=>workspaceCall('browser','browser.open',{url}),inspectBrowser:(pageId)=>workspaceCall('browser','browser.inspect',{pageId}),listDesktopWindows:()=>workspaceCall('computer','desktop.windows'),selectDesktopWindow:(window)=>workspaceCall('computer','desktop.select',window),inspectDesktop:()=>workspaceCall('computer','desktop.inspect')}}); globalThis.AvenApprovalBridgeUI.mountApprovalBridgePane(existingWorkspacePane,client,{getScope:currentReviewScope,adapterIdentity:currentAdapterIdentity,getInventory:currentAdapterInventory})
clientRequirements: Mount uses globalThis.__avenWorkspaceExecutionBridge.call(kind,operation,input) for existing browser.open/browser.inspect (root adds the scoped workspace open route) and desktop.windows/desktop.select/desktop.inspect; the pane exposes explicit Open and inspect browser URL, List desktop windows, Select and inspect desktop window, and Connect this target controls. Each target comes from the existing adapter; never invent pageId, window or control identifiers. Browser context is headless and adapter-owned.
Map chat Agent mode to inspect and chat Plan mode to plan; only an explicit write review flow may call preview/approve/execute.

Pass currentReviewScope, currentAdapterIdentity and currentAdapterInventory (already available read-only adapter inventory) into mountApprovalBridgePane; network/device writes stay unavailable until a separate recovery-plan seam exists.
Keep all scoped and approval tokens in the client request closure; never write them to localStorage, chat history, JSON or event payloads.

Show human action, adapter-selected target, bounded current value or unavailable, affected targets, impact limits and rollback unavailable; do not make digest/session/token the main pane output. Chat revert is not device/browser rollback.

deferredToRoot: Apply the server and existing workspace pane hooks above.
Run composed HTTP/browser verification under the root-owned browser lease and keep integrated/live status distinct.
